title: Senior Product Manager, Enterprise Security Technology
jd_excerpt:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 Job Category 
Product 
 Job Details 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 What You’ll Be Doing & Why It Matters
The Enterprise Security Technology team builds and operates the technology solutions that keep our employees and business safe. Employees interact with our solutions every day to enable them to do their job while maintaining Salesforce’s #1 value of trust.
We are looking for an individual to help ensure that we enable our employees to get their jobs done while keeping them and their devices safe and secure.
We are looking for an experienced Product Manager for Enterprise Security Technology to lead the product strategy and roadmap for key parts of our overall IAM solution stack and work with engineering to deliver solutions that reduce risk for Salesforce. This person will be part of the enterprise security PM team helping deliver Enterprise Security Technology solutions for Salesforce.
This role requires a deep understanding of the cybersecurity landscape and IAM, excellent communications and leadership skills, and a proven track record of building and deploying successful security solutions within a large enterprise.
The ideal candidate has a proven track record leading product management in security and/or enterprise services and strong technical knowledge to work with security architects to help define the best overall solution. They should know how to put the customer and user at the center of their work, translating business and user requests into requirements and solutions.
They are data-driven, ensuring we are strategically working toward the right outcomes and have a strong bias for action.
Core Responsibilities & Scope
 Vision, Strategy, & Roadmap - You help set strategic vision with executive management and the roadmaps needed to get there. Customers, Partners, and Collaborators - You will engage with customers, partners, and internal collaborators to resolve business requirements, technical considerations, and strategic goals. 
 Planning, Delivery, and Execution - Additionally, you will collaborate with engineering and operations peers to deliver both strategic and tactical plans and objectives. You are hands-on and involved in getting results delivered. 
 Market & Product Analysis - Conduct market research, comparative analysis, and customer feedback sessions to identify new opportunities and make build vs buy recommendations. Product Lifecycle Management - Oversee the entire product lifecycle from ideation to end-of-life, ensuring timely and high-quality product delivery. 
 Subject Matter Expertise - Represent your area as a subject matter expert with our internal and external stakeholders. Success Metrics & Impact - Define key metrics to measure business outcomes, user adoption, risk reduction, and operational efficiency, regularly reporting results to leadership. 
Minimum Requirements
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree desirable. 8+ years of experience in technical product management or a related role. 
 Proven ability to define and deliver successful product strategies and roadmaps. Demonstrated experience in defining technical product requirements into an actionable product roadmap. Experience working and delivering product or services in an agile/lean environment. Strong understanding of agile product development methodologies. 
 Excellent written and oral communication skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership. Strong interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate with diverse teams and stakeholders in a matrix environment. 
 Deep expertise in various cybersecurity domains, especially IAM, but ideally including network security, cloud security, and data protection; in depth knowledge of Identity protocols and standards (SAML, OIDC, OAuth, SCIM, FIDO, etc.); access control models (RBAC, PBAC, Zero Trust, Least Privilege, JIT, Privileged Access Management); authentication / MFA strategies (FIDO2, Phishing resistant MFA, device identity, non-human and Agentic identity); application onboarding and M&A integration experience; familiarity with AI Security & Governance: Working knowledge or familiarity with securing AI workloads, managing agentic identities and lifecycles, and applying access controls for Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI tools; working knowledge of leading 3rd party identity vendor solutions such as Okta, SailPoint, CyberArk (Idira), Active Directory, Entra, Zscaler, Palo Alto, and Crowdstrike. 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 
 Accommodations 
 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com. 
At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions.

The typical base salary range for this position is $172,500 - $260,100 annually. 

The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.
